verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions branch protection, rulesets, required status checks, or any way to block a pull request from merging until checks pass. GitHub Actions (github-docs-38) and CI/CD (github-docs-11) are described only as customizable automation, not as enforced merge gates. Push protection (github-docs-15) blocks pushes containing secrets, which is not a merge check. Merge gating is a fair axis for a code-hosting platform, so the missing evidence yields "none" rather than "na".
